description: The Rhine Falls spreads wide across the river, breaking around the central rock, with Schloss Laufen on the south cliff and Schloss Wörth on the near side. Existing visitor railings belong to the real viewpoint and are not expanded into new scaffolding. Spray and gray water match a cloudy afternoon. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and windy, with no rain.

qc_notes.note: Approval withdrawn 2026-09-25 (Cosmo QC): the weather metadata was a shared/batch Open-Meteo retrieval (retrieval timestamp 2026-09-24T12:40:09Z identical across 12 scenes), failing Gate 2 under the confirmed standing policy — one HTTP fetch per scene, one recorded retrieval timestamp per scene; identical-to-the-second timestamps across scenes = shared retrieval. Rework: fetch Open-Meteo fresh per scene (own HTTP request, own recorded timestamp), scenario hour inside the model-valid hour; update the approvals note with the new retrieval evidence; re-push masters only if on-image text must change. Scene stays Candidate until Cosmo QC re-audits.
